blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The decision of Vice President Sara Duterte’s lawyers to cite deceased individuals to support their arguments reeks of desperation, according to Lanao del Sur Rep. Zia Alonto Adiong, who added that the move signals that the defense’s arguments are also nearing their death. During a press briefing on Thursday, held during a break in the impeachment proceedings, Adiong questioned whether the defense’s use of video clips of former Senator Miriam Defensor-Santiago and former Chief Justice Renato Corona showed desperation and a lack of witnesses who could explain the allegations against Duterte.
